DataFusion:
Sort: test_steps DESC NULLS LAST, m.trace_id ASC NULLS LAST, fetch=50
  Projection: m.trace_id, count(Int64(1)) AS count(*) AS test_steps
    Filter: count(Int64(1)) >= Int64(3)
      Aggregate: groupBy=[[m.trace_id]], aggr=[[count(Int64(1))]]
        ModelRegion

      Scan issue_messages as m [content, trace_id, role] where m.role = 'assistant'
